'''Jewelry''' is a group of wearable items sold by the [[Jeweler]]: earrings and a circlet, worn in the head slot. The four gem pieces each give a permanent status effect while worn, bought with [[Obol]]s and a gem from a structure or a boss. Three plain pairs of earrings are purely decorative.

The developer deliberately gave jewelry no advancements explaining it, preferring that players find out what it does on their own.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.03|quote=So, some things, I will not give advancements for (Jewellery, Special Books, Villages, Fetishes (that one im iffy on), etc.), and I think its cooler that way.}}</ref>

== Properties ==
All jewelry is built on a netherite helmet, which gives it these properties:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/2/ruby_circlet.json}}</ref>
* It is worn in the '''head slot''', so it replaces a helmet. Only one piece of jewelry can be worn at a time, and wearing jewelry means giving up a helmet's armor and any helmet intrinsics.
* It gives 1 [[armor]] point, with no armor toughness or knockback resistance.
* It is '''unbreakable'''.
* Like netherite, it doesn't burn in fire or lava when dropped.

The gem effects are intrinsic enchantments that run every tick while the piece is worn by a player, reapplying a 1-second hidden effect. The effect therefore lasts as long as the jewelry is worn and wears off shortly after it is taken off.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/conduit_power.json}}</ref>
* '''Opal Earrings''' give Dolphin's Grace at all times and Conduit Power only while the wearer is in water.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/conduit_power.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''Ruby Circlet''' gives Fire Resistance.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/fire_proof.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''Amber Earrings''' give 3 seconds of Regeneration I whenever the wearer has no Regeneration, which amounts to constant Regeneration I.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/regeneration.mcfunction}}</ref> Since Matcha Flavoured has no [[natural regeneration]], this is one of the few ways to heal without eating.
* '''Topaz Earrings''' give Haste II.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/haste.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Gems ==
Each gem comes from a different source and unlocks one piece of gem jewelry. The [[Jeweler]] buys gems back at Master level.
{| class="wikitable"
! Gem !! Source !! Jeweler pays !! Advancement
|-
| {{ItemLink|Opal}} || Killing an {{MCW|Elder Guardian}} || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} || ''Canto I'': "Defeat the Sea God"
|-
| {{ItemLink|Ruby}} || [[Bastion Remnant]] chests || 8 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} || ''Canto II'': "Pillage the Remnants of Pandaemonium"
|-
| {{ItemLink|Amber}} || [[Archaeology|Brushing]] suspicious blocks in trail ruins || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} || ''Canto III'': "Exhume the Pilgrim's Trails"
|-
| {{ItemLink|Topaz}} || [[Ancient City|Ancient city]] chests || 10 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} || ''Canto IV'': "Raid Tartarus"
|}
The four ''Canto'' advancements form a chain in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab. The first three each reward a [[Crystal Heart]], and ''Canto IV'' rewards two.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/obtain_topaz.json}}</ref>

== Nazar Circlet ==
The resource pack contains a worn texture for a '''nazar circlet''', but there is no item, recipe or trade for it. It is not obtainable in the current version.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/matcha/equipment/nazar_circlet.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* The developer on the plain earrings: "They don't do anything but they ARE very cute".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.2|quote=Diamond, Amethyst, and Lapis Earrings (They don't do anything but they ARE very cute)}}</ref>
* The jewelry textures for the amber and opal earrings were originally made by a community artist and edited by the developer.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.1-alpha|quote=The amber earring and opal earring textures were orginally made by (INSERT NAME HERE). I edited them to my taste}}</ref>
